title: binder v0 processing_log entry
description: One entry of processing_log[]. Entries a v0 implementation writes carry op_id and follow these rules; legacy entries are accepted as they are. Single source of the log_entry_v0 copy. Unknown fields are allowed and preserved.
$comment: Rules for entries a v0 implementation writes, which always carry op_id. Entries without op_id are legacy and unconstrained; lifeproj's rule that any entry with an id closes that item holds for them whatever their action.

id.$comment: A v0 id is a non-empty string or a non-zero integer, compared by JSON type and value (section 5.6). Ids are copied with their type.
id.description: Only on a closure: the closed item's id exactly as it appears in the catalog, with its JSON type, never slice-prefixed.

item.$comment: A v0 id is a non-empty string or a non-zero integer, compared by JSON type and value (section 5.6). Ids are copied with their type.
item.description: An item the entry is about without closing it.

document.description: A document the entry is about.

final.description: The closed item's other fields as they were (section 5.10).

reopened_from.$comment: A v0 id is a non-empty string or a non-zero integer, compared by JSON type and value (section 5.6). Ids are copied with their type.

allOf.$comment: An entry that carries id is a closure: done or dropped, with the closing details and the item as it was.
A closure of an item whose id was already closed in the processing log: no id, so no id repeats (section 6.8).
